description: The 'commits' dataset provides detailed information about changes made to software projects. It includes metadata about each commit, such as the project key, commit ID, author, and timestamp, as well as quantitative data on the number of files and lines added, removed, or changed. This dataset is particularly useful for software development teams and project managers who need to track changes over time, analyze the impact of specific commits, or understand the contributions of different authors. By examining this data, users can gain insights into the development process, identify trends in code changes, and assess the productivity and focus areas of the development team. The dataset's structure allows for easy integration with version control systems and can be used for generating reports, visualizations, or feeding into analytics tools to improve project management and decision-making processes.
shortDesc: Dataset of software project commits with metadata and changes.

columns.name: project_key
columns.comment: Unique identifier for the software project.

columns.name: author
columns.comment: Name or identifier of the commit author.

columns.name: timestamp
columns.comment: Time when the commit was made, in milliseconds.

columns.name: added_files
columns.comment: Number of files added in the commit.

columns.name: added_lines
columns.comment: Number of lines added in the commit.

columns.name: removed_files
columns.comment: Number of files removed in the commit.

columns.name: removed_lines
columns.comment: Number of lines removed in the commit.

columns.name: changed_files
columns.comment: Number of files changed in the commit.
